UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Stores a user's semester class schedules, tasks/deadlines, and notification preferences.

schedules.description: Map of semester names to lists of scheduled classes.

tasks.description: List of academic tasks, assignments, exams, and events.

notifSettings.description: User preferences for class and task notifications and haptics.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user workspace document keyed by the authenticated Firebase user UID.
